chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Fadhl from Zarif ibn Nasih said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "Do not mix with or do business with anyone except one who was raised in goodness."

key_terms.نَشَأَ فِي اَلْخَيْرِ: Raised in goodness (referring to upbringing and moral formation)

ai.seo_question: Who should a Muslim choose for business and social interaction according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links commercial integrity to early moral formation, suggesting that a background in 'khayr' (goodness) serves as a reliable heuristic for trustworthiness in trade. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *sira* (conduct) and *khuluq* (character) as foundational to valid *mu'amalat*, ensuring that economic transactions are not merely legally sound but spiritually and ethically robust.
